Da-Nia
The Earthlings know Gaw-La Furia exists,@and Her Highness and Granteed Dracodeus@have been taken.
What's more, the <Gate of Voda> is about to open again.@Despite such an emergency,@why do the Knights not move?
Gu-Landon
I am not sitting idle.@Preparations are under way.
Preparations? This is no time to dawdle.@What will you do if the Vaula appear?
If you will not act, then I shall order the Knights...
Know your place, Chief Chancellor.@It is I who rule the Fury now.
Wha...!
Besides, even if the Gate of Voda opens, there's@no need to close it quickly. It saves us the trouble.
What are you...?!
It is not Princess Shana-Mia, scheming to coexist@with the Earthlings, who shall build the Fury's future.@It is I, Gu-Landon Gortz.
H-Have you lost your mind?!@Such a thing will not be permitted!
What is permitted is mine to decide.@Da-Nia Gelt, your role is over.
Karo-Ran
...Take him away.
Agent
Sir!
Insolence! I am the Chief Chancellor!@I have served the imperial family@here in Gaw-La for ages...!!
Fear not.@In recognition of your service, your remains will be@laid to rest in the Grove of Timefaring.
W-Wait! I-I am...!!
...Now then, the Princess's flight worked in our favor@in the end, but we must recover the keys soon.
I know.@I'll send Fu-Ruu to keep the Steel Dragons in check.
Is that all?
It would be best if we could retake the Throne Unit...@but for now, what matters is preparing@Gaw-La Furia and the Zee-Gadin.
So I don't want to provoke the Earthlings@more than necessary.
Even so, we must find out where the Princess is.@I'll send out Jua-Mu from our side as well.
Yeah, got it.

Hagane - Briefing Room
Security Guard
Excuse me.@I've brought Princess Shana-Mia@and Touya Shiun.
Thank you. You may go.
(The commander, the captain and Major Gilliam...)
(If they called me here too...@this has to be about@Granteed Dracodeus.)
Miles
Now, Princess Shana-Mia.@The Earth Federation Army's top brass have reached@a provisional decision on how you're to be treated.
First, we cannot officially treat you@as a member of the Fury's imperial family.
Shana-Mia
In other words, you doubt whether I am truly@the Princess of the Fury.
That is the brass's judgment, yes.
What?! Granteed Dracodeus@is all the proof you need!
...I didn't give you permission to speak.
But...!
It's all right, Tou-Ya.
Officially, it is as I just said,@but within this unit, we will trust@Your Highness's word.
Or rather, so that we can trust it,@we'd like to conduct a certain test.
What would that involve, exactly?
Neutron, heavy ion and gamma radiation@are currently intensifying at the Cross Gate.@We see it as a sign of a burst, but...
We would like to verify Your Highness's claim@that Granteed Dracodeus@can seal the Gate.
I understand.@Tou-Ya, please lend me your strength.
Yeah... I'm not sure I can do it like my dad did,@but if I'm the only one who can...
Commander Miles...@If we can seal the Cross Gate, your superiors@will believe what I've told you, won't they?
However, if Gu-Landon let@the <Ruina> appear unchecked...
Then I must say that reconciliation between@Earth and the Fury will be difficult.
If there's any chance of it,@it'll be after Gu-Landon is defeated.
That... may be true.
I'll ask you bluntly.@How likely is it that Gaw-La Furia@will start moving?
I can't say. If they bring Gaw-La out into the open,@Gu-Landon and the others would be putting@their own stronghold at risk.
So they might dig in and hold out.
When the decisive battle comes,@I will board the Throne Unit too.
Are you serious...?!
Yes. Not only this matter, but the Ruina's appearance@as well... I'm to blame for allowing Gu-Landon@to run amok.
But...
Is it wrong for me to fight alongside you?
It's not that.@But you'd be turning your blade on your own people.@Are you really okay with that?
As bait for Gu-Landon's forces,@you couldn't ask for better.
Tou-Ya, I want to stop the war between the Fury@and Earth. Now that the Vaula may return through@the Gate of Voda, I can't be choosy about the means.
But if Her Highness, Touya and Granteed@Dracodeus were all recaptured at once,@the situation would get dramatically worse.
You're quite right. To prevent that,@I hope to borrow all of your strength.
And after that, if need be,@I will serve as your guide to Gaw-La.
Do you mean you'd assist us in an invasion@of the Fury's home base?
...I believe that if I take power back from Gu-Landon,@talks toward peace will become possible.@Please think of it as a step toward that.
Understood.@Your Highness riding in Granteed@means taking on a great risk, but...
Since our orders from the Joint Chiefs are@to confirm whether the power to seal the Cross Gate@exists, there's no avoiding it.
Captain, our unit will answer Princess@Shana-Mia's request with everything we have.
Your Highness, for security reasons,@please refrain from leaving the room@you'll be staying in.
I'll be watched too, I take it? That's fine.
(...In the worst case, the commander and the others@might intend to destroy Gaw-La Furia...)
(But I saw it there.@All those Fury sleeping in the Grove of Timefaring...)
(Shana-Mia is trying to protect them.@Now that Dad's gone, I have to help her...)
Let me pass on what Princess Shana-Mia told us@about the Fury's special attack, Larseilam.
First, the only units equipped with it are@Granteed Dracodeus, the Raftclans@and the Coustwell Brachium.
Larseilam requires an energy charge@and puts a strain on the unit,@so it can't be used repeatedly.
Also, the barrier called the Stasis Field@lasts about five minutes at most.
And a special substance called Eitelum@forms the core of Larseilam.@Apparently it has a limited service life.
What happens when it hits the limit?
Apparently it shatters right then.
(That's why So-Des lost to me...)
Eitelum is only found on the Fury's home world,@so right now they can't resupply it.
Just like Tronium.
So once all the Eitelum hits its limit,@the Fury can't use Larseilam anymore...
Do we know how many uses@each unit has left?
Apparently even the Fury don't know that.
So you won't know until you actually use it...
Also, Fury knights can't use Larseilam@without permission.
Raji

However, the operatives known as Agents@apparently aren't bound by that.
Any countermeasures besides the Time Flow Engine...?
Granteed Dracodeus, which has Larseilam itself@and can move inside a Stasis Field.
If the Fury throw in every@Larseilam-equipped unit they have,@won't we be in for a hard fight?
Whether they're willing to use up their trump cards@fighting us... That's the gamble.
